title: Non-reporting of the ARR shall lead to denial of benefits under the RODTEP
text: 2. Non-reporting of the ARR shall lead to denial of benefits under the RODTEP scheme and no further scroll out of RODTEP claims for the SBs will be permitted at the Customs Port of Export after the grace period of three (3) months i.e. after 30th June.
intent: Support Non-reporting of the ARR shall lead to denial of benefits under the RODTEP processing and compliance validation.
